topic: Performance Optimization Techniques: Loop Unrolling and Reassociation
explanation: Loop unrolling and reassociation are performance optimization techniques used to improve the efficiency of computations, especially in the context of vector processing and parallel architectures. Loop unrolling reduces loop overhead by replicating the loop body multiple times, while reassociation changes the order of operations to better utilize hardware resources, such as parallel functional units. Both techniques aim to increase instruction-level parallelism and reduce the number of cycles required for computation.
